_readme: Layout for build_course.py. World frame: origin at the pool centre, +x toward section D, +y toward the TOP of the map image, +z up, water surface at z = 0.
map_px = [column, row] pixel on the 1920x992 top-view map. Pool calibration below was measured from that image (pool edges and red section dividers).
To move a prop: edit its map_px, or replace it with xy_m = [x, y] in metres (xy_m wins if both are given).
yaw_deg: counter-clockwise as seen from above (same sense as the map). For meshes with align = principal, the mesh's longest horizontal axis is rotated to point this way (mod 180).

rotate_deg (optional, per mesh): [rx, ry, rz] degrees about the world x, y, z axes (right-hand rule, applied in that order) after the up-axis fix, e.g. [0, 90, 0] turns a part about the y axis. yaw_deg on an item still turns it about the vertical axis on the map.
anchor: floor = bottom of the mesh rests on the pool floor; surface = top of the mesh touches the water surface (hanging); z = bottom of the mesh at z_m.
